notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content: [p]Hi guys. I tried to release the update version 1.3 for the game. In this update, based on your requests, I have added a [b]difficulty settings[/b] to the game, and now when you start a new game, you can choose between Easy, Normal and Hard difficulty. Also [b]2 new Achievements[/b] and the [b]Brazilian subtitles[/b] has been added to the game. [/p][p]Please let me know if there's anything you think needs to be added to the game so that I can add them in future updates. Thank you again for support my new game! 🙏[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Difficulty settings added (Easy + Normal + Hard)[/p][/*][*][p]2 New Achievements added[/p][/*][*][p]Brazilian subtitles added[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content: [p]Hi guys! I hope you're doing well. I noticed some of you were having trouble defeating the bosses, so I tried to make them a bit easier (not too much ːsteammockingː) Also, you can easily bind your preferred keys for movement in the game's settings. Thank you for supporting my game! [/p][p][/p][p][/p]
